cases.outcome_quote: Cheesy Bean & Rice Burrito at $1.49* and Cheesy Fiesta Potatoes at $2.49*

cases.announce_quote: the cereal is being sold at select Walmart stores
cases.outcome_quote: proud to re-launch the beloved brand
cases.outcome_note: The January 2021 return was a short limited run that sold out, and in June 2022 Post re-launched Waffle Crisp as a regular cereal; coded on that later action.
cases.confidence_reason: The announce source is a retailer-availability report dated 18 Jan 2021 that quotes no one from Post (Wikipedia: 'In January 2021, Post Foods decided to return Waffle Crisp'). The 2022 relaunch is sourced, but no page shows it still on national shelves at Jan 2023. Mixed evidence: coded on the most recent company action. The control term 'post' alone is too ambiguous, hence 'post cereal'.

cases.announce_quote: for a limited time beginning January 2023
cases.outcome_quote: now it's actually back and will actually be available to purchase
cases.outcome_note: After the limited January 2023 retail run, PepsiCo ran an eclipse sweepstakes in April 2024, which was not a sale. From Sept 2024 Pitch Black returned as a fountain-only drink at Speedway and 7-Eleven.
cases.confidence_reason: The brand's own statement to Food Network dates the signal to its 15 Nov 2022 social post (article 16 Nov). The Sept 2024 chain-exclusive fountain run (Sporked, 26 Sep 2024) falls inside 24 months. It is not a national regular item, though Sporked says it is not a limited-time release at those chains. A search term of 'pitch black' alone may pick up unrelated searches; consider 'mountain dew pitch black'.

cases.outcome_quote: shortly after the promotion, it went missing once again
cases.outcome_note: Popeyes brought Cajun Rice back only for its 50th-anniversary promotion. It then vanished, and its next sourced return was in select locations in Feb 2025, outside the window.
cases.confidence_reason: The announcement is the same-day 21 Jun 2022 coverage of the Popeyes anniversary release; Audacy (22 Jun 2022) says 'if for a limited time only'. The Mashed outcome piece (28 Apr 2024) is inside 24 months but is a listicle; Fast Food Post (6 Feb 2025) dates the next return. The search term needs the brand because 'cajun rice' is a generic dish.
